primary_analysis: Execute paired_binary_analysis_v1 on paired confirmatory tasks (n=120). For each task read binary end-to-end correctness for pipeline A (translation-first/baseline) and pipeline B (agentic/guarded) from paired_binary_episode_v1 results; compute per-task paired difference (A−B), aggregate point estimate (mean paired difference), bootstrap 95% CI, and McNemar two-sided p-value. Report sample size after contamination exclusions and full execution-manifest provenance (hashes).
secondary_analyses: Repair coverage difference between pipelines (fraction of initial failures repaired within allowed repair budget) with 95% CIs and effect size.
Mean repair iterations per task for pipeline B (guarded) with 95% CI and Wilcoxon comparison vs A where applicable.
Transient unsafe-proposal rate per pipeline (fraction of proposals flagged transient-unsafe by deterministic validators) with 95% CIs.
sensitivity_analyses: Failed-call sensitivity: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat single-pipeline failures as zero) and report effect on primary estimand.
Contamination sensitivity: include vs exclude tasks flagged by contamination_plan (simulator↔device disagreement or grammar 'unknown construct') and report estimates.
Sample-budget sensitivity: report primary-estimand estimates under preregistered alternative scenarios SCEN-LOW-80 and SCEN-CONS-120-WORST using archived manifest subsets.
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: paired (task-level) bootstrap 95% confidence interval for mean paired difference (paired bootstrap, reproducible seed, 10,000 resamples as provided by executor). Report McNemar p-value for paired binary outcomes. Secondary: bootstrap or Wilcoxon CIs as appropriate; report exact p-values and effect-size measures (risk difference, rank-biserial where used). All CIs and p-values generated by paired_binary_analysis_v1 and archived with seeds and code.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary confirmatory test is single paired estimand at α=0.05. Secondary tests and subgroup analyses (vendor/topology) are multiplicity-controlled per preregistration using Benjamini–Hochberg false-discovery-rate procedure at FDR=0.05; exploratory analyses labeled as exploratory (no confirmatory α control).
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan: (1) run simulator-fidelity checks on held-out suite and report simulator↔device disagreement; (2) run grammar-coverage unit tests and report uncovered constructs; (3) verify execution isolation tokens for each model call. Flag tasks where simulator↔device disagreement>5% or parser reports 'unknown construct'; primary analysis excludes flagged tasks (document exclusions and counts); sensitivity analyses include flagged items to assess robustness. All contamination flags and related hashes logged from execution manifest.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Confirmatory paired-summary: n (pairs included), successes_A, successes_B, paired mean difference (A−B), bootstrap 95% CI, McNemar p-value; provenance: execution_manifest and execution/scoring/*.json files.

Table 2 — Secondary outcomes by pipeline: repair_coverage, mean_repair_iterations, transient_unsafe_rate with 95% CIs and Wilcoxon or exact-test statistics; per-pipeline columns; data derived from execution/result_schema (paired_binary_episode_v1) and execution/scoring/*.json.

Table 3 — Subgroup breakdown: vendor×topology cells reporting successes_A, successes_B, paired difference, BH-adjusted p-value (FDR 0.05); include cell counts and exclusions; data from task_manifest.jsonl + scoring files.

Table 4 — Execution and provenance summary: planned vs completed episodes, model_calls_used, failed_episode_count, exclusions_count with reason categories (contamination, infrastructure), and key artifact hashes (execution_manifest.artifact_hashes).
figure_specifications: Figure 1 — Success-rate comparison: paired bar chart (A vs B) with bootstrap 95% error bars and annotated paired-difference estimate; data from execution/scoring/*.json and paired_binary_analysis_v1 output.
Figure 2 — Distribution of repair iterations: histogram/boxplot for pipeline B (guarded) showing counts and median; data from scoring files (repair-iteration counts).

Figure 3 — Failure-mode composition: stacked bar or pie chart of failure-mode categories (translation error, semantic hallucination, verifier-model mismatch, simulator-model mismatch) aggregated across pipelines; derived from failure-mode taxonomy in scoring artifacts.

Figure 4 — Per-task paired differences: scatter or violin of per-task (A−B) across tasks, colored by vendor/topology clusters and marking excluded/flagged tasks; data from paired_binary_episode_v1 and task_manifest.jsonl.
